jobs.name: 조약돌
jobs.prompt:
Draw ONE new player aircraft sprite for our 2D game, using the attached image as a reference ONLY for simple pixel art detail level. User's new request: make the design look SOFTER AND ROUNDER. Stay as simple as the reference but noticeably gentler in all shapes.
Orthographic overhead view. Exactly FIVE attached short outward-facing turret modules, equally spaced around the center: top, upper right, lower right, lower left, upper left. One connected flying machine; no extra turrets, no front cockpit. The gun bases are little rounded oval caps, barrels very short 2-pixel wide and 3-pixel long with rounded end and dark muzzle. Make them read as compact functional turrets, not fingers. Avoid tall square gun blocks seen in the reference.
48x48 logical pixel art shown enlarged nearest-neighbor, uniform square pixel clusters. 42x42 full silhouette in 48x48 canvas with margin. Actual transparent background, isolated centered sprite. Crisp pixel edges arranged into smooth stair-step curves, not blurry or anti-aliased. About 12 colors, 2-3 flat shades per material. Soft muted low-saturation colors, medium slate outline rather than heavy black. Wide plain matte armor surfaces, gentle single crescent-shaped highlight on upper-left face, subdued shadows. Only one tiny painted geometric mark at center and two tiny vent marks, no other decoration.
No gold or metallic trim, no sharp spikes, no arrowhead plates, no blade tips, no polygonal ridges, no elaborate mechanisms, no shiny bevels, no glow/bloom, no gradients, no surface noise/scratches, no jewelry, no realistic material, no excess detail. Simple but not blank: restrained panel separation and tiny painted center mark. Don't add eyes or faces. No words, no UI, no floor, no shadow outside sprite, no firing effects. Make an appealing soft rounded mechanical toy-like silhouette that still belongs to a subdued fantasy arcade game.
DESIGN: A compact smooth circular saucer shaped like a flattened rounded pebble. Warm ivory/greige hull, muted taupe underside and slate-gray five small oval turret caps snug to outer rim. Broad continuous round body, no lobed petals and no star points. Center has a small round gray inset and one cream painted dash. Two subtle short curved panel seams, generous flat areas.
